title: Front matter every tracked plan/architecture doc carries so staleness is detectable
description:
YAML front matter at the top of the .md file:
---
status: current
describes: [scripts/motionmix_studio_engine.py, lume-wiring/render/]
verified_at: 2026-10-21
verified_commit: 9ce2284
owner_lane: air-deck-ableton-integration
---

superseded_by.description: repo path of the doc that replaces this one; required when status=superseded

describes.description: code paths (files or dir prefixes) this doc makes claims about; required when status=current

verified_commit.description: commit at which the claims were last checked against the code
